_notes: B6 — Badge piece-out (catalog B6, plan test-plans/journey-b/b06-badge-piece-out.md, recording docs/media/journey-b/b06-badge-piece-out.mp4, PET-12644 automation / WEBPET-1525 manual, runner row B6-001). Transport, not simulation, happy path only.

The badge scan and the badge→employee resolution are device-side — the Piezas screen resolves the owner before the scan ever leaves the device (plan kf 9/13/21/93) — so what reaches the office is a PieceOut row already carrying its employee via EmployeeSource BarcodeBadge. The in-range duplicate suppression is device-side too and never reaches an envelope (B6-R8).

The record carries no Ranch and no Field, mirroring the recording (kf 173), which also rules out WEBPET-1409 Time-In synthesis structurally: that PostSave hook returns early without a bound Field. expected.cards[0] states both as null, so the office is now asserted to have stored neither — the old spec relied on the absence and never checked it.

transport single-folder: the envelope is pushed to the office mailbox (the relay leg the old spec asserted) and then uploaded through POST connectivity/import/single-folder, the importer-contract path — the shortest route to a proven import, and the one this workflow has always used.

modules: Piece Payment comes from PT_MODULES on the API task, which short-circuits the TigerMaster query entirely (auth/modules.go:569-571) — TigerMaster already licenses Piece Payment (moduleId 36), so /admin/tm cannot clear this gate. Documented on every run, never enforced: if false, that is expected until PT_MODULES is updated by DevOps (PET-12689), and piece CAPTURE is unaffected.

extraEmployees: seedOfficeFixture only ensures the crew's own members, so B6's sticker employee is ensured here, as B4/B5 do. dayOffset -6 keeps 6005's employee-day away from B5 (-7) and B4 (-8) under workers=2.

expected.absentCardType 1: after the import the fixture day must hold no Time In for the scanned employee — the WEBPET-1409 guard, asserted so a later preference or envelope change cannot leave an orphan behind.

expected.grid.texts are the two grid cells the recording shows (kf 127): the Type column and the Employee Selection column. The grid is fed by POST /transfer-to-job-cards/analyze; when that flag is off the helper annotates and returns no row, and the API assertions above still stand.

cleanup: the timeCards step sweeps 6005's fixture day (both card types — a stray Time-Out pairs with a Time-In and silently removes the warning) before the import and deletes the imported card after the test; the flow passes sweep:false so exactly one cleanup path is live.
